statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPNicAccessConfig)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPNetworkInterface)<-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(:GCPInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP NIC access configs that no longer exist (an external IP removed from a VM). Runs before the NIC delete so a stale NIC's configs are not orphaned.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPNicAccessConfig)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(:GCPNetworkInterface)<-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(:GCPInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP NetworkInterface-to-NicAccessConfig relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPSubnet)<-[r:PART_OF_SUBNET]-(:GCPNetworkInterface)<-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(:GCPInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove NetworkInterface-to-Subnet relationships that are out of date: a NIC moved to another subnet, or an edge to a parentless stub subnet keyed by the NIC's .../regions/... self-link (before NICs used the subnet loader's .../locations/... id). Anchored on the instance's project, so it also covers NICs on a Shared VPC host project's subnets.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPNetworkInterface)<-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(:GCPInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Network interfaces that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes.
